source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Coarse heavy-duty dyed sail-bunting and stencilled corsair cloth on a saturated blood-crimson ground (#a61c1c) banded horizontally with tar-black (#18191c) broad-stripes and hemp-rope (#a68b5b) whip-stitched seams, block-printed in bleached bone-ivory (#e6dfd0) and charcoal-soot (#1c1a18) with three repeats across and two down of a weathered skull poised above crossed thigh-bones flanked by twin raked catamaran prows and barbed harpoon heads, seam-safe. Full colour.
